[Constants]
;================================= EDHM v22.03 ========================================================
;  ** Shield Colour Mode **
; 100 = Custom Multi-Color shield (see Advanced.ini)
; 101 = Custom single Color (see Advanced.ini)
; 199 = XML
; 200 = Elite default
z105 = 100
;  ** Chat Panel Lines **
x137 = 199
;  ** Radar Brightness **
; Default = 1.0
w142 = 1.25
;  ** Text Colour **
; Red
x115 = 0.8
; Green
y115 = 0.3663
; Blue
z115 = 1
files.Advanced:
; A line that looks like a setting before the section starts is not one.
x1 = 0.111
  [constants]   ; the header may be indented, in any case, with text after it
;================ comments, blank lines and spacing all stay as they are ================

; Red
x232 = 0.5
; Green, with odd spacing and a comment after the number
   y232   =    0.25   ; trailing comment stays
; Blue, with no spaces at all
z232=1
; Brightness, written without a leading zero
w232 = .75
; A number in exponent form
x77 = 1.5e-3
; A negative number
y77 = -0.21
; Tabs instead of spaces
z77	=	0.3
; Settings that are commented out do not exist
;x90 = 0.9
; x91 = 0.9
; The same key twice: only the first one changes
x50 = 0.1
x50 = 0.2
; A short key must not match a longer one that starts the same way
x10 = 0.3
x23 = 0.4
x2 = 0.6
; Not a number, or nothing at all
x60 = abc
x61 =
; Text straight after the number is kept
x62 = 0.5abc
; Keys are case-sensitive
X70 = 0.7
; A plus sign is not part of a number
x71 = +0.5
; Values sent as numbers rather than text
y40 = 0.5
z40 = 1
[Other]
; Another section: nothing in here may change
x232 = 9.9
x80 = 8.8
[Constants]
; Only the first [Constants] section counts
y232 = 7.7
